furnace.prompt: A close view on the wide stone rim of a huge silicon furnace: the flat rim runs across the front of the picture, glowing white-orange melt below and beyond it, a chute high on the left pouring pale quartz lumps and black carbon lumps down onto the rim.

stage.where: on the flat stone rim in the front middle
stage.near: the quartz and carbon lumps on the rim are about its own size, the rim stones much bigger

furnace.variant: the glow of the melt flickers a little brighter

inside.prompt: On the floor of a silicon furnace, among pale quartz lumps and black carbon lumps, glowing melt and heat haze behind, and on the right a vent in the furnace wall where wisps of gas drift up and away.

stage.where: on the floor in the front left
stage.near: the lumps around it are about its own size; the vent on the right is a doorway much taller than it

pour.variant: the steam has drifted up and the pouring stream ripples
